featured_reviews.name: Kavita Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Celebrated my birthday with a food distribution drive, and it turned out to be truly meaningful. The team was supportive, well-organized, and made everything seamless.

Seeing the smiles of kids and the gratitude from hospital patients reminded me that small acts can create a big impact. Kudos to the team of We Can We Will Foundation!!! Truly inspiring work—this experience motivates me to keep giving back.

Special thanks to Pankaj, Kalam, and Vijendraji for their amazing work and constant support 🙏

featured_reviews.name: Hridaay V Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text:
My name is Vir Hriday Shetty ..I'm a Grade 8 Student in Inodai Waldorf School . In September 2025 our school initiated that Community Service should be done by all students from Grade 8 onwards . My parents did the research and they found We Can We Will foundation on the internet . I came with them and did my initiation where they explained the various programmes and charity work which is done by the Foundation. I started to Volunteer and took my first lecture for small children on 15th September.Thereon I've been volunteering in teaching and helping students with their studies and some of them with their computer projects ..the most endearing and enjoyable part of my weekly schedules were the Food Drives where I joined every weekend . It is very satisfying and I feel very proud and happy to be of help to others.
Simpal ma'am ..Kalaam Sir and all the others are extremely dedicated and committed as a team . Im glad Im part of WCWW and even after I finish my Certification hours ..I will continue to serve the underprivileged hand in hand with the foundation. Helping others at We Can We Will has also taught me lot as I'm growing up .
I would like to thank Simple Ma'am ..Kalaam sir and everyone who has guided me here.
Thank you WCWW.

featured_reviews.name: Ishita Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text: Volunteering at We Can We Will has been such a heartwarming experience! Thanks to the entire team, which is so warm and welcoming, and go beyond their role to accommodate and help. Can't help but get extremely attached to the kids, who receive such critical and important life skills at the foundation. Extremely grateful for the entire experience, looking forward to seeing whats in store next!

featured_reviews.name: Siya
featured_reviews.review_text:
Volunteering and teaching  with the We Can We Will Foundation has been such a heartwarming experience for me. It never felt like “just volunteering” — it felt like being part of something truly meaningful.  The students  here are incredibly kind and welcoming, and the energy is so positive that it instantly makes you feel comfortable. Every small task, every interaction, feels like it actually makes a difference, which is something really special.
I’m genuinely grateful for this experience. It’s not just about helping others, it’s about growing, learning, and realizing how powerful even small acts of kindness can be.

featured_reviews.name: Shipra Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text: I've been volunteering with We Can We Will Foundation for a while now, and it's honestly one of the best decisions I've made. The kids are so eager to learn and their smiles light up the whole room every time. The team and other volunteers feel like a real family—everyone is supportive, kind, and truly passionate about helping underprivileged children with education and food drives. Sessions are well-organized, whether teaching in person or joining activities, and there's a lot of freedom to contribute in ways that suit you. Every visit leaves me feeling hopeful, peaceful, and recharged. It's rewarding to see the small changes we're making together. Highly recommend if you're looking for meaningful volunteering

featured_reviews.name: Shreya Nihalani
featured_reviews.review_text:
My experience as a volunteer at the WCWW Foundation this year has been truly enriching & meaningful.

From participating in food drives at municipal hospitals to conducting skill development workshops for students & old age home residents, I learned resilience, responsibility & the importance of community service.

The guidance & support from my mentors, Riddhi Ma’am & Kalam Sir, was quintessential throughout this experience, & I look forward to continuing to be a part of the NGO in the future.😊

featured_reviews.name: Meet Bhateliya 1234
featured_reviews.review_text: I’ve been volunteering with We Can We Will Foundation for some time now, and it’s honestly been a really nice experience. They genuinely notice and appreciate the work volunteers put in, which feels motivating. Everyone there is very kind, supportive, and easy to work with. The environment is positive and welcoming. Happy to be a small part of the work they’re doing 😊🌟🤝

featured_reviews.name: Naman Jain
featured_reviews.review_text: We Can We Will Foundation is truly making a difference with the incredible work they do. The team is warm, kind, and highly professional, creating a welcoming and supportive environment for everyone involved. Their passion for bringing positive change to the community is inspiring and evident in everything they do. I had a wonderful experience and deeply value their dedication. I highly recommend this foundation to anyone looking to contribute to a meaningful and impactful cause.

name: HWCT India Foundation - Human Welfare Charitable Trust
description: HWCT INDIA FOUNDATION is a Public Charitable Trust, Non-Profit, Charitable Organization, established in 2015 with the primary goal of reaching out to support the weaker economic sections of the society. HWCT focuses on Education, Skill Development amongst children, youth and women in Mumbai & Rural Maharashtra. HWCT is working by supporting over 17 schools and shelter at Naigaon with the integration of the right education system implementation program, skills programs, enabling the children to lay their foundation of a progressive future. We leverage our long-standing partnerships, dedicated schools,and skill resources to build community-driven solutions, spark life-changing innovations and elevate ideas with the help of individuals.

name: Aftertaste Foundation | Art for Empowerment | Women Empowerment | NGO in Malad, Mumbai
description:
"Empowered women= Empowered family"

At Aftertaste we are trying to address problem of economic and social poverty using a 2-pronged approach. We realised that women in the community play a significant role in economic growth and overall social upliftment of families and communities.
Aftertaste's work started with economic empowerment of the women of the community using art and craft as a medium and enabling the women to earn a dignified livelihood. Through the process of skilling and livelihood generation we are able to bring about social change by empowering the women with knowledge and exposure in the areas of education, healthcare and financial literacy that leads to an improvement of the socio-economic condition of their families.

featured_reviews.name: GM Lotlikar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am totally disappointed and heartbroken with my experience at Yoda NGO situated at Malad Chikuwadi. I had sent my cat for sterilization and kept following up from day one, but my messages and calls were continuously ignored. Despite my repeated requests for updates, I wasn’t informed about my cat’s condition or whereabouts.

After 15 days of constant follow-ups, I was shocked to learn that my cat had been released five days earlier without any prior intimation or confirmation from me. To make things worse, my cat was left without my permission in a location that is extremely difficult to find. This is extremely irresponsible and careless behavior.

Animals are not just “cases” they are family. My cat was like my baby.  I had some emotional sentiments connection with my cat. NGOs like Yoda are expected to show compassion, transparency, and accountability, not negligence. What happened to my cat should never happen to anyone else.

Please, if you truly care for animals, think twice before trusting this organization with your pets.

#AnimalWelfare #AccountabilityMatters #YodaNGO #AnimalCare
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hello, 

We’re truly sorry to hear about your experience and completely understand how upsetting this must have been for you. We never intend for any pet parent to go through distress, and your feedback is extremely valuable to us.

Please share your contact details via IG or WhatsApp us at +91 90821 08895 or reach out to us directly at +91 80-62689333 or social@yoda.co.in so that we can look into what went wrong in your cat’s case and ensure this never happens again.

We genuinely care for every animal that comes to us, and we’d like the opportunity to address this personally and make things right.

featured_reviews.name: Mritunjay Kumar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Thanks to organisers of Upasana society for collaborating with WanderingSaga and arranging such an awesome fun filled ride followed by camping.

It really was a thrilling experience. You guys always kept us on our toes (atleast me if not others). I was always trying to figure out what next and where next. The fun level seemed to be increasing with every passing hour.

Highlights of the show:

- Panoramic view of the range of mountains the moment you enter that region. Rohan, next time if & when you go you must take a halt for 10 min there. Let everyone enjoy that view
- Tent activity was fun filled.
- Boomerangs we made at the not so waterfall. Laughed my heart out :p Micro-mini trekk we had there. Truly unexplored place
- Unexpected rain. Seems like even nature wants to join you guys in surprising the riders
- Awesome local food cooked on wood fire. Amazing taste. Gaon ki yaad aa gayi
- KP ki story-telling. Have heard the stories before but still want to hear. Makes me remember the line " Travelling - it leaves you speechless, and then turns you into a storyteller"
- Dipti and Mallika's mid-night yoga session.

Dipti, You rock girl🤘🤘
Keep up the good work you have started. Looking forward for more such events...

featured_reviews.name: Bhoumesh Patil
featured_reviews.review_text:
Saurabh and Dipti! I happened to discuss about ngo with Saurabh and let me tell you that the vision behind this NGO is unique. I don't know how to put it in words.

Simply put It's like treating the root causes rather than working on the situation. It's about precaution rather than working on the cure.

Talk to Dipti and she will let you know the ground reality. Working for good has never been an easy task. It's about changing the mindset. Just distributing "goods" doesn't work.

Upasana is indeed a game-changer in its field.
All the best!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank u very much. Your kind words mean a lot 🙏🙏

featured_reviews.name: Vinit Lotlikar
featured_reviews.review_text: A great initiative by Saurabh and Dipti, this NGO is doing great job in providing valuable awaerness about menstrual hygeine and biodegradable products, social awareness for betterment of environmental cleanliness and providing support to local empowerment. I was a part of the event organised by trekraw and Upasna society called tracial which was an unplanned travel with unknown souls with a social touch. Social touch included providing locals a chance for travel, food etc rather then booking through digital platforms and also make  some fellow commuters aware of environmental cleanliness. Would like to be further associated with this NGO for volunteering in the activities they do and would highyh recommend it for others too.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thanks a lot Vinit. Your feedback means a lot to us

featured_reviews.name: DARSHANA BHANDARI
featured_reviews.review_text:
Experiencing my first menstrual cycle using a menstrual cup.. it's quite comfortable.. Not scary atall as they show on YouTube..I m sure that's for their virality sake. That they over show the initial problems or confusion in first time use.

I am glad I am switching to a cup, coz even though Its my first periods with it..I am not that confident coz what if I don't use it perfectly.. but I m sure about using it coz eventually I will be perfect at using one.

Coz the very first thing it is environmental friendly, and very very cost effective for a person especially who have high flow..
It have reduced the chances of infection from the sanitary products I have been using since so many years.. I am 30 years old, married and a mother of a child. So I feel lucky that I attended the seminar conducted by Mrs.Dipti ..I knew about cups but before I was scared to use it..
For the enumber of myths online. But through her seminar I really felt like giving it a try..n he I am .. Never going to leave using menstrual cup ever..

Regards Darshana Bhandari, Bhayander.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you Darshana for sharing your experience with us. This will motivate other girls to make the switch. This is transformation. We are glad that we could help you cupvert. Have a happy period 😊
